verdict.rationale: Omnara is a hosted and self-hostable agent platform with pricing plans, so plan-based task and concurrency limits are a fair question for it. The evidence pack only mentions free self-hosting, bring-your-own model keys, and a community reference to a $20/month price. Nothing documents daily task quotas, concurrency limits, or a way to view or manage them.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
